# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 and rolling up all v4 breaking changes. It adds variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and SKStream.GetData(). The singleton lifecycle is reworked and legacy 3.x paint/font APIs are promoted to compile errors. This is a breaking release — review the changes below before upgrading from 3.x.

## Breaking Changes

- **new SKFont() now has an empty typeface** — Upstream m132 removed the lazy-default pattern. new SKFont() now stores SKTypeface.Empty, so MeasureText returns 0 and nothing is drawn. Construct with an explicit typeface (e.g. new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)) and detect an unset typeface with font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of a null check. ([#3735](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3735))
- **new SKPaint().Typeface returns Default instead of null** — SKPaint now seeds SKTypeface.Default. Text still draws correctly. Replace null guards with paint.Typeface.IsEmpty or drop them — a usable default is always present. SKPaint.Reset() also restores that default. ([#3736](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3736))
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName always returns a non-null typeface** — Android previously returned null for an unknown family; all platforms now return SKTypeface.Default. For strict null semantics use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style), which still returns null on no match. ([#3737](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3737))
- **SKTypeface.Default resolved through the font manager** — The native sk_typeface_ref_default() path was removed upstream. Default resolution now uses the font manager. SKTypeface.Default is guaranteed non-null on every platform. No migration needed. ([#3738](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3738))
- **SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and throws for out-of-range offsets** — The native offset is 32-bit; the long overload previously truncated silently. It now uses checked((int)offset) and throws OverflowException for out-of-range values (CS0618 warning). Call Move(int) with a validated in-range offset. ([#3740](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3740))
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null** — Skia m139/m140 requires Vulkan 1.1. A 1.0 instance triggers SK_ABORT (process termination). Set VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1 and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1. Leaving MaxAPIVersion at 0 is unsafe. Genuinely 1.0-only hardware must use a different backend.
- **GRVkBackendContextNative lost five fields** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed. Replace fExtensions with fVkExtensions, fFeatures with fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2. fOwnsInstanceAndDevice has no replacement. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped; GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo loses value-equality** — YcbcrConversionInfo is now GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (was GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo), and the old type no longer implements IEquatable<T> nor equality operators. Update type references and replace == / Equals comparisons with field-by-field checks. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed** — The protected setter was removed; the property is now get-only. Subclasses that assigned IgnorePublicDispose = true must pass the flag through a constructor parameter instead.
- **Legacy SKPaint text/font members are now compile errors** — Members obsoleted in 3.x (paint text size, typeface, legacy text state) are promoted to errors in 4.x. Move text and font state to SKFont. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))

## Engine

- **Upgraded to Skia milestone m148** — The bundled engine advances from the v3 m133 pin through m147 to m148, picking up years of upstream fixes, performance work, and Ganesh/Graphite GPU backend improvements. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **Upstream chrome/m147 bug-fix syncs merged** — Cherry-picked upstream bug fixes from the m147 release line are included. ([#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081))

## API Surface

- **Variable font support** — SKTypeface exposes font-variation axes and named instances; DrawText honours variation settings. HarfBuzzSharp gains matching variable-font shaping support. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding via SKWebpEncoder** — New SKWebpEncoder overloads let you build and encode multi-frame animated WebP files. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy data extraction** — New GetData() returns the underlying SKData without copying, avoiding an extra allocation for memory-backed streams. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **SKSamplingOptions added to DrawSurface** — SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept SKSamplingOptions, enabling quality control for surface-to-surface compositing. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **HBColor struct for hb_color_t representation** — A new HBColor value type correctly wraps hb_color_t, replacing the previous uint representation and fixing color-font palette access. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and offset corrected** — GetPixelSpan(x, y) used Height instead of Width for the column offset; the stride calculation now uses RowBytes, matching native behaviour. ([#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148))
- **SKPath finalizer crash fixed** — When SKPathBuilder was collected before SKPath, the finalizer accessed freed memory. The reference is now kept alive for the path's lifetime. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Default typeface resolution fixed on Android API 36+** — Android API 36+ could crash during SKTypeface.Default resolution; the managed layer now falls back to SKTypeface.Empty instead. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKGLView rendering restored after MAUI TabBar tab switch** — The GL surface was not properly reinstated after a tab-switch on Android, causing a blank view. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers fixed** — The WinUI .NET 9 projection path was missing; it is now correctly included in the NuGet package. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton instance lifecycle reworked** — Creation, caching, and disposal of singleton SKObjects (default typeface, font manager, etc.) is now deterministic: created on first access, released on explicit Dispose or process shutdown. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native-compat gate moved to SkiaApi static constructor** — The version-compatibility check previously in a [ModuleInitializer] is now in the SkiaApi cctor, making load-time error messages clearer. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Apple platform TFMs corrected** — Library targets now use versioned TFMs (26.0) while app targets use unversioned ones, matching Apple's current SDK layout. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **Linux Bionic native assets added** — A new native asset set built against the Android NDK Bionic sysroot allows SkiaSharp to run in Linux environments that use an Android-style libc. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen x64 and arm64 native builds** — The Tizen native build now produces x64 and arm64 libraries in addition to the existing arm build. ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **WASM pre-.NET 8 Emscripten native builds dropped** — Legacy Emscripten builds for WASM targets older than .NET 8 are removed; the minimum supported Emscripten version is aligned with .NET 8. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## Security

- **Native dependency refreshes** — Bundled libraries updated: expat 2.8.1, libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1, libpng 1.6.58, libexpat 2.7.5, freetype 2.14.3, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley, and HarfBuzz 14.2.0. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Adds variable-font shaping, the new HBColor value type for color-font palette access, and Linux Bionic native assets. Bundles HarfBuzz 14.2.0 with TreatWarningsAsErrors cleanup and Skottie sample fixes.
